main_text.l: Partis Homines discriminentur à Francisco Davi-
dianis, aliisque quibuscunque Anti-Trinitariis, qui
necessarium hunc Fidei Articulum viz. Christum
invocandum atque adorandum esse, ut divinæ Ma-
jestatis factum participem,
abnegarunt: Ex hac au-
tem Socini Sententia sequitur, si paritas Rationis
valeat, Catholicos non esse culpandos ex eo, quod
Socinianos è Cœtibus suis excludant, & à Sacris
arceant, eo quod Fidei Articulos ad salutem, ut
Ipsi judicant, necessarios, palam & obstinate negent.
Neque ex hoc etiam, quod certas publicarum pre-
cum Formulas Ministris injungant, ex officio usurpandas,
ut hac nota dignoscantur ab Hæreticis,
Fideque Catholicam aperte profiteantur. E. G.
Quibus Trinitas Personarum invocatur, tum con-
junctim, tum separatim; potestas Regum à Deo
solo derivari agnoscitur, illique soli subdita; satis-
factio Christi pro universi Generis humani
peccatis, in officio Eucharistico; Necessitas Gratiæ di-
vinæ ad Tentationes superandas omneque opus bo-
num perficiendum, à Deo indefinenter petendæ;
Reatus peccati originalis, statusque damnationis inde
consequentis, qui in officio Baptismali exponitur;
efficacia utriusque Sacramenti, veraque Christi præ-
sentia in Cœna Dominica; Resurrectio ejusdem nu-
mero Corporis, quæ in officio funebri asseritur;
Insolubile Conjugii vinculum in officio Matrimonii;
ministrorum Evangelicorum, sive cleri triplex ordo,
& necessitas ordinationis ad opus ministerii, ab iis
solemniter peragendæ, qui ad hoc potestatem habent
in Ecclesia à Christo, ejusque Apostolis communica-
tam[?], in officio ordinationis; Denique, Potestas cla-
vium in excommunicatione Communicatam[?] & read-
missione Pœnitentium, sive in ligando & absolvendo; quam

page.notes: Running head and the word "Communicatam" (second occurrence, excommunicatione line) are smudged; readings doubtful. The line "Fideque" and "omneque" follow the print as seen, with possible printing errors. A small stray mark at the bottom left is not text and is left out. The first line of text has no indent, so the paragraph continues from the previous page. The text is set as one paragraph, since no new indented paragraph is visible.
